## Release notes

State the user-visible change in one or two sentences, or write **Not user-visible**.

## Checklist

- [ ] The project builds successfully.
- [ ] I tested the change using the affected deployment method.
- [ ] Existing GarageLog data is not overwritten or silently deleted.
- [ ] No credentials, private documents, personal records, databases, logs, or generated build output were committed.
- [ ] New external services or network calls are documented and justified.
- [ ] The version number was changed only when preparing an actual release.
- [ ] Documentation and screenshots were updated where needed.
